conventions.units: metres in the FBX (UnitScaleFactor 100 = metres); 1 m = 3.5714 studs
conventions.axes: FBX -Z forward, Y up; table/Roblox (x, y, z) = Blender (x, -z, y)
conventions.pivots: object origin = table pivot; pivot_offset_studs = pivot minus bbox centre, Roblox axes
conventions.normal_maps: tangent space, OpenGL (+Y up), MikkTSpace on the triangulated mesh
conventions.textures: 8-bit PNG; Color is sRGB; Normal, Roughness, Metalness are linear
conventions.parts: one material per object; a mesh with a second material ships as <name> plus <name>_<Inner|Paint|Lens|Door> with the same pivot (parts / part_of link them)

PAD_Deflector.name: PAD_Deflector
PAD_Deflector.notes: Slope faces +Z and up: top-face normal (0, 0.814, 0.581) in table axes, i.e. the plate is turned 35.5 deg about X so its high edge is at the back (z -1.44, y 6.63) and it sheds the exhaust downrange into PAD_Trench. PAD_Lines.name: PAD_Lines
PAD_Lines.notes: Line A runs from SITE_Sphere_0's outlet flange face (-64.39, 1.10, 52.88) to the manifold, ending inside it at (-9.6, 1.1, 4.2); line B from SITE_Sphere_1's flange face (-82.39, 1.10, 36.88) to (-9.4, 1.1, 5.4). Both leave their flanges along azimuth -42.4, in line with the nozzles, behind a mating flange. A turns south at x -9.6 and enters the manifold's north face so the lines never cross; B enters the west face along z 5.4. 6 + 8 concrete pedestals (none on the apron edge or the asphalt ring). One mesh, one material.

PAD_Mount.name: PAD_Mount
PAD_Mount.notes: PAD_Lines end inside the manifold block on the west face (table x -10.2..-9.0, z 3.5..6.1, y 0.4..2.2). A riser climbs from it to the deck. The deluge ring sits under the deck opening.

PAD_Trench.name: PAD_Trench
PAD_Trench.notes: Floor10..Floor70 sit on the floor centreline every 10 m for the ground-cloud emitters; Exit is the trench end (0, 2.5, 72). The floor top is at y 0.42, 2 cm above the apron; PAD_Apron and PAD_Apron_Centre leave a slot under it (|x| < 4.3 from z 3, |x| < 5.5 from z 10), so nothing z-fights. Floor edges run 0.12 m below the apron top and the walls 0.45 m, so no gaps show.

SITE_Car.name: SITE_Car
SITE_Car.notes: Placement: 34 copies of SITE_Car with SITE_Car_Paint (one pivot, so both parts take the same CFrame), car i = 0..33 at (-662 + (i % 17) * 2.7, 0, 58 + floor(i / 17) * 13), yaw 90 deg about Y (nose toward -Z, the range-ops building), as in the mood study. If the car-park surface is raised (mood study asphalt top y 0.14), raise the cars by the same amount. Paint: SITE_Car_Paint is its own part; put SurfaceAppearance.Color on it only. Paint map average sRGB (0.833, 0.833, 0.833), linear (0.740, 0.740, 0.740). Tints that reproduce the six mood-study paints (linear-space multiply): white #d8d8d4 -> Color #f7f7f2 (247, 247, 242), black #1d1f22 -> Color #232528 (35, 37, 40), grey #7d8086 -> Color #90939a (144, 147, 154), dark red #5a1f1c -> Color #682522 (104, 37, 34), navy #22324a -> Color #283b56 (40, 59, 86), beige #b9b2a4 -> Color #d4ccbc (212, 204, 188). If Roblox multiplied in sRGB space instead, the tints differ by at most 12/255. Colour assignment (the mood study picks paints at random; this is a fixed mix): paint index per car i, 0 white 1 black 2 grey 3 dark red 4 navy 5 beige: 0210514023012504120310245102301420 (white 10, black 7, grey 7, dark red 3, navy 4, beige 3). Front toward +X before the yaw; seen from 2 km or more, so the 256 maps are deliberate.

SITE_Car_Paint.name: SITE_Car_Paint
SITE_Car_Paint.notes: The paint material of SITE_Car as its own part, since Roblox gives each MeshPart one material. Same pivot as SITE_Car: give it the same CFrame, or keep both in one Model. Counts toward SITE_Car's budget.

SITE_DistantPad.name: SITE_DistantPad
SITE_DistantPad.notes: Placement: 3 copies, yaw 0, pivots at (320, 0, -1900), (160, 0, 2300) and (-700, 0, -2800) (the mood study's distantPad calls). Beacon: red obstruction light on the tower top at (-11, 82.6, 0) local, flashing like the mood study's distant-pad beacons. Silhouette only: tower 7 x 82 x 7 m at x - 11 (painted lattice), rocket r 2.3 x 66 m with a black interstage and an ogive fairing, service arm at 55-57 m, water tower column r 2 and sphere r 7 at (x + 60, z + 40). Flat colours (steel #45484d, white #dedad3) under haze. Nothing here casts useful shadows at 2-10 km: CastShadow off is fine.

SITE_FencePost.name: SITE_FencePost
SITE_FencePost.notes: Placement: 145 copies, yaw 0 (round post). Post i at angle a = i * 360/147 deg (from +X toward +Z), position (140 cos a, 0, 140 sin a), i = 0..146, skipping x < 0 with |z| < 6 (the road gap at i = 73 and 74, which leaves a 17.9 m opening on the -X side where the access road leaves the pad). Rails: two Beams per bay, RailLow (y 1.1) and RailHigh (y 2.3), each joining post i to the next kept post; no Beam across the road gap. Mood-study rails are galvanised tube r 0.035 (#a3a5a8): Beam Width 0.07 m. Galvanised steel, the same family as the mood study's steelLight.

SITE_Flag.name: SITE_Flag
SITE_Flag.notes: Rig: SITE_Flag_Rig (exported with the mesh in SITE.fbx) holds Root (static, up the pole; pole, collar, finial and the hoist column weighted 100% to it) and the chain Fly0..Fly5 (1 m each, hoist to tip, each the parent of the next). Cloth weights blend linearly between neighbouring bones (max 2 per vertex). Rest pose: flat, flying toward table azimuth 74.9 deg (the mood study's wind), obverse facing Cam 6. Bone rest heads (table m): Root head (-2448.8, 0.0, -1268.7); Fly0 head (-2448.7742, 12.05, -1268.6034); Fly1 head (-2448.5142, 12.05, -1267.6378); Fly2 head (-2448.2542, 12.05, -1266.6721); Fly3 head (-2447.9941, 12.05, -1265.7065); Fly4 head (-2447.7344, 12.05, -1264.741); Fly5 head (-2447.4744, 12.05, -1263.7753). Bone axes in Roblox space: Root is identity; every Fly bone has local Y along the fly (0.2600, 0, 0.9656), local Z straight up (0, 1, 0) and local X the cloth's front normal (-0.9656, 0, 0.2600). Wave: Bone.Transform = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, theta_k) rotates about local Z (vertical), a horizontal wave; an optional droop is a small negative angle about local X. MeshPart.DoubleSided = true: the cloth is a single sheet (the back shows the mirrored print, like a sewn flag). Hinge0/Hinge1 mark the hoist edge (vertical, upward); the flag moves only through its bones, so there is no rigid hinge angle. Tested wave (1.5 s per cycle, 4.8 m wavelength, travelling hoist to fly): a_k = A[k] * sin(2*pi*t/1.5 - 2*pi*(k + 0.5)/4.8) with A = {0.08, 0.13, 0.18, 0.23, 0.28, 0.33} rad, then Fly_k.Transform = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, a_k - a_(k-1)) with a_(-1) = 0 (each Transform is relative to its parent, so pass the difference). The rig object is rotated +90 deg about X in Blender so armature space is Y-up: spad.export_fbx then writes SITE_Flag_Rig as an identity-rotation node at the pole base, like the mesh.

SITE_FloodPole.name: SITE_FloodPole
SITE_FloodPole.notes: Modelled once at the origin with the lamps aimed toward +X. Place four copies of SITE_FloodPole with SITE_FloodPole_Lens (one pivot, so both parts take the same CFrame), rotated about +Y (right-hand rule, table axes; CFrame.Angles(0, rad(yaw), 0)) so the lamps face the pad centre: (34, 0, 34) yaw +135; (-34, 0, 34) yaw +45; (34, 0, -34) yaw -135; (-34, 0, -34) yaw -45. Lamp0..3 are the lens centres; each lamp's beam axis is (cos 12.6, sin 12.6, 0) before the yaw. SITE_FloodPole_Lens, the four lens faces as their own part, is drawn in the lit state (bright warm white with the reflector pattern): by day tint it down (SurfaceAppearance.Color about #3b3e43, the mood study's dark glass) and restore white with the glow at night.

SITE_Mast.name: SITE_Mast
SITE_Mast.notes: Modelled once at the origin; place three copies at (52.99, 0, 23.59), (-46.92, 0, 34.09), (-6.06, 0, -57.68) (r 58 at azimuths 24, 144, 264), yaw 0 for all three, which keeps the mid beacon on the +Z side as in the mood study. Beacon (118.6 m) flashes, BeaconMid (60 m, bulb centre 0.8 m off the axis on its bracket) burns steady. Beams: WireTop to WireTop between neighbouring masts with 14 m sag, and one down-guy per mast from WireTop to a ground anchor at (121.87, 0, 54.26), (-107.92, 0, 78.41), (-13.94, 0, -132.67) respectively (2.3 x the mast position, 5 m sag).

SITE_PowerPole.name: SITE_PowerPole
SITE_PowerPole.notes: Placement: 40 copies at (x, 0, 11) with x = -160 - 48k, k = 0..39 (x -160 to -2032, the mood study's loop), yaw 0: the crossarm runs along Z and sits on the pole's +X side. Conductors: 3 Beams per span (39 spans, 117 Beams), Conductor_n of pole k to Conductor_n of pole k+1, dark #1c1c1e, Width about 0.03 m (thicker if they shimmer at distance). Sag 1.2 m at mid-span: a Beam is a cubic Bezier, so set Axis = (0, -1, 0) on every Conductor attachment and CurveSize0 = 1.6, CurveSize1 = -1.6 (mid-span sag = 0.75 x 1.6 m). The middle conductor passes 0.1 m over the pole top. Wood #4d4134 (creosote-treated pole, greyer weathered crossarm), grey porcelain insulators.

SITE_RangeOps.name: SITE_RangeOps
SITE_RangeOps.notes: Modelled in place; pivot at the base centre (-640, 0, 34). Entrance and canopy on the +Z face (toward the car park); roof slab top at y 9.6. The rooftop units and stair penthouse (to y 12.6) are an addition for the silhouette; the mood study has a bare slab.

SITE_Sphere_0.name: SITE_Sphere_0
SITE_Sphere_0.notes: Two linked copies of one mesh: SITE_Sphere_0 at base (-70, 0, 58), SITE_Sphere_1 at (-88, 0, 42). The outlet nozzle (r 0.42, centre y 1.1) leaves toward azimuth -42.4 (between the two line directions) and ends in a flange r 0.66: Sphere_0 flange face (-64.39, 1.10, 52.88), 0.96 m short of the line start (-64, 52); Sphere_1 flange face (-82.39, 1.10, 36.88), 0.41 m short of the line start (-82, 37). SITE_TankH_0.name: SITE_TankH_0
SITE_TankH_0.notes: Two linked copies of one mesh: SITE_TankH_0 centred at (-62, 2.8, -50), SITE_TankH_1 at (-62, 2.8, -58). SITE_WaterTower.name: SITE_WaterTower
SITE_WaterTower.notes: Modelled in place; pivot at the base centre (95, 0, -85). Beacon: steady red bulb (r ~0.26) resting on the stub on top of the roof deck. The door at the foot faces the pad (azimuth 135); an overflow pipe runs down the column at azimuth 160 on four stand-off brackets.

TWR_CrewArm.name: TWR_CrewArm
TWR_CrewArm.notes: Static. The white room's hatch seal (+X face) is at x -2.70, 10 cm off the fairing; the doorway on its -X face opens onto the walkway. Walkway deck top at 66.36 m, flush with the platform.

TWR_FuelArm.name: TWR_FuelArm
TWR_FuelArm.notes: Swing: rotate -72 deg about the Hinge0->Hinge1 axis (+Y; right-hand rule, table coordinates) from T-25 to T-19, eased (smoothstep); the tip moves toward +Z and the arm folds back along the tower's +X face. Swept in 1 deg steps against the lattice, booster, interstage, grid fins and stage 2: no contact. Closest: 2 cm at the hinge bearings, 6-7 cm under the 54 m beam and over the 52.2 m deck, 16 cm to the corner leg when folded, 22 cm to the interstage when extended. The Vent attachment feeds the disconnect steam; stop it as the arm swings. Truss offset 0.35 m toward -Z of the hinge, raked tip and 1.24 m depth (guide 1.4) are what keep the swing clear.

TWR_Lattice_A.name: TWR_Lattice_A
TWR_Lattice_A.notes: Painted dark steel. Pipes up the +X face feed the fuel arm at 52.4 m.

TWR_Lattice_B.name: TWR_Lattice_B
TWR_Lattice_B.notes: Painted dark steel. Pipes up the +X face feed the fuel arm at 52.4 m. BeaconMid0 (SE corner) and BeaconMid1 (SW corner) at 44 m burn steady. The fuel arm's swivel housing and bearings are part of this section; the +X face bay 48-54 m has no bracing above the 52.2 m deck, which leaves room for the arm's swing.

TWR_Lattice_C.name: TWR_Lattice_C
TWR_Lattice_C.notes: Painted dark steel. Pipes up the +X face feed the fuel arm at 52.4 m. BeaconMast (mast tip, 104.6 m) flashes; the mood study uses a 1.5 s period. BeaconTop0-3 on the roof corners (88.6 m) burn steady. Roof deck at 88 m with a stair hatch; mast r 0.35-0.2 to 104 m.

VEG_Belt_0.name: VEG_Belt_0
VEG_Belt_0.notes: Merged far trees (mood-study placement, exact). Modelled in place: import with the file's scene positions (pivot = base centre on the ground, y 0). Set RenderFidelity = Precise: the tiles sit 1.2-7 km from the cameras, and distance LOD would strip the tree silhouettes on the long lenses. Shares the VEG_Belt texture set with every other tile (one SurfaceAppearance). CanCollide/CanTouch/CanQuery off, CastShadow off is fine.

VEG_Scrub_A.name: VEG_Scrub_A
VEG_Scrub_A.notes:
Placed in Studio, 1,600 instances shared with VEG_Palmetto, by the mood study's rule (table metres):
repeat until 1,600 are placed: cluster centre at radius 90 + 900*sqrt(u), angle 2*pi*u; n = 3 + floor(7u) members, each at centre + ((u - 0.5)*26, (u - 0.5)*26) in x, z. Skip a member (no more draws for it) if x > 438, r < 86, |z| < 9 with x < -70 (road), x -205..-120 with z -95..-45 or x -195..-135 with z -60..0 (hangar), x -695..-585 with z 14..88 (range ops), or |z - 11| < 2.5 with x < -150 (power line). Otherwise draw sc = 1.1 + 2.4u; palmetto if u < 0.35; yaw = 6.28u (CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)); scrub only: kx = 1 + 0.6u, ky = 0.45 + 0.35u, kz = 1 + 0.6u; then ci = floor(5u) (floor(3u) for palmetto) and cm = 0.8 + 0.4u. Scrub: VEG_Scrub_A/B/C by floor(3*(cm - 0.8)/0.4); Size = native Size * sc * (kx/1.3, (0.25 + 0.851*ky)/0.782, kz/1.3). Palmetto: VEG_Palmetto_A/B by floor(2*(cm - 0.8)/0.4); Size = native Size * sc. Pivot at the base centre, on the ground (y 0). For the mood study's exact layout, u is its mulberry32 stream (seed 1977) after discarding the first 41,992 values; any other uniform source gives the same look. If the stream differs, also skip within 12 m of the sphere centres, x -76..-48 with z -64..-44 (tanks) and within 6 m of the water tower. Variants are modelled at the mood study's sc = 1 size. The meshes carry softened custom normals: import with the file's normals. Each variant has its own texture set.
